lessons: Redo the fix: in clutch/meta.py::_render, rstrip each `f"{key}: {values[key]}"` line. Update the `purpose: \n` expectation to `purpose:\n` in tests/unit/test_meta_refresh.py and tests/unit/test_meta_cli.py. Review found that approach sound, and the verification command passed.

Cause: Check's check_meta runs the engine's installed, pre-fix meta.py. It inserted a meta block with `# purpose: ` (trailing space) into the new test file, which had none. So `ruff format --check` failed at tests/unit/test_meta_render_no_trailing_space.py:4.

Commit tests/unit/test_meta_render_no_trailing_space.py with its meta block already present. Run `uv run clutch meta refresh` on it in the worktree, then fill in a non-empty purpose (e.g. `# purpose: guards meta render against trailing whitespace`) so check_meta keeps the block instead of rewriting
Before committing, run `uv run clutch meta check` and `uv run ruff format --check .` in the worktree. Confirm the new test file has a valid, non-drifted block with no trailing whitespace on any line.
